<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919515_theRebbe_764" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919515_theRebbe_764__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the superiority of the Third Temple over the First and Second Temples, introducing the unique quality of the Temple's location as not being a mundane place.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the superiority of the Third Temple over the First and Second Temples</t>
    <t s="2">(also over the Second Temple as it was meant to be in the form of the pattern of the Third Temple),</t>
    <t s="3">will be understood by prefacing the quality of the Holy Temple</t>
    <t s="4">(in general),30</t>
    <t s="5">including also the quality of the place of the Temple,</t>
    <t s="6">that the place of the Temple</t>
    <t s="7">(even before the building of the Holy Temple)</t>
    <t s="8">is superior to the place of the entire world,</t>
    <t s="9">as it is written,31</t>
    <t s="10">"How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of G-d," and Onkelos translates, "This is not a mundane place."</t>
    <t s="11">For the place of the entire world is a mundane place, because it was created with ten utterances, which are called32</t>
    <t s="12">"mundane words,"</t>
    <t s="13">but the place of the Temple is not a mundane place</t>
    <t s="14">[Even though the place of the Temple was also created with ten utterances.</t>
    <t s="15">On the contrary,</t>
    <t s="16">the beginning and essence of creation from the ten utterances was the creation of the Foundation Stone in the Temple, and from it the entire world was founded33],</t>
    <t s="17">for with the ten utterances it is said "And G-d said,"</t>
    <t s="18">but in the place of the Temple there was a revelation of the Name Havayah, as it is written,34</t>
    <t s="19">"Indeed, Havayah is in this place."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section clarifies that the superiority of the Temple's place is intrinsic to the place itself, not just the revelation there, explaining that its creation was such that the Name Elokim does not conceal the Name Havayah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And explanation is needed,</t>
    <t s="1">for at first glance,</t>
    <t s="2">the superiority of the place of the Temple over the place of the entire world is in the revelation that was in the Holy Temple, and not in the place itself,</t>
    <t s="3">for even the place of the Temple was created with ten utterances</t>
    <t s="4">(mundane words),</t>
    <t s="5">and the meaning of "This is not a mundane place" is that the place itself is not a mundane place.</t>
    <t s="6">And the point of the explanation of this is according to what is stated in Tanya35</t>
    <t s="7">that the coming-into-being of the world is from the Name Havayah</t>
    <t s="8">(Havayah is a term meaning "He brings into being"36),</t>
    <t s="9">except that if the coming-into-being were from the Name Havayah itself, the world would be nullified in existence; therefore, the actual coming-into-being was through the Name Elokim.</t>
    <t s="10">And the coming-into-being of the place of the Temple was in a manner that the Name Elokim does not conceal the Name Havayah.</t>
    <t s="11">And this is "This is not a mundane place," because in the place of the Temple, the coming-into-being was felt in revelation as it is from the Name Havayah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section distinguishes between two modes of creation—through enclothing and through a spontaneous manner—indicating the proximity or distance of the created being from its source.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="1">that coming-into-being from the Name Elokim is in a manner of enclothing</t>
    <t s="2">("In the beginning, Elokim created"37)</t>
    <t s="3">and coming-into-being from the Name Havayah is in a manner of spontaneity</t>
    <t s="4">("Let them praise the Name of Havayah, for He commanded and they were created"38).</t>
    <t s="5">And the difference in the manner of coming-into-being</t>
    <t s="6">(whether the coming-into-being is in a spontaneous manner or whether it is in a manner of enclothing)</t>
    <t s="7">indicates the relationship of the thing being brought into being to the source that brings it into being.</t>
    <t s="8">For when the thing being brought into being is close to the bringer-into-being,</t>
    <t s="9">its coming-into-being is in a spontaneous manner.39</t>
    <t s="10">And like a cause and an effect,</t>
    <t s="11">since the effect is commensurate with the cause,</t>
    <t s="12">therefore the coming-into-being of the effect from the cause is in a spontaneous manner</t>
    <t s="13">[And like intellect and emotions,</t>
    <t s="14">since the emotion is commensurate with the intellect,</t>
    <t s="15">therefore,</t>
    <t s="16">through contemplation,</t>
    <t s="17">the emotion corresponding to the contemplation comes spontaneously].</t>
    <t s="18">And likewise is it with light and a luminary,40</t>
    <t s="19">since the light is a revelation of the luminary,</t>
    <t s="20">therefore,</t>
    <t s="21">the emergence of the light from the luminary is in a spontaneous manner.</t>
    <t s="22">And when the thing being brought into being is distant from the bringer-into-being,</t>
    <t s="23">its coming-into-being is in a manner of enclothing,39</t>
    <t s="24">that the bringer-into-being busies and exerts itself to bring the thing being brought into being into existence.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
